ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels (>90%) with discrete, localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing approximately 5-8% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a continuous dark-pigmented macro-blob. High-contrast white focal points are localized at coordinates corresponding to the mid-left lobe (circular constellation) and lower-right lobe (scattered points).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide-angle V-shaped depression at the center; the base of the notch is partially obscured by low-intensity water spray, but the converging lobe boundaries suggest an obtuse angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; visible peaks and valleys are densely distributed along the entire trailing edge of both lobes with significant pixel-amplitude variation at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the superior edge of the lobes, terminating in sharp, upwards-pointing distal tips with high-texture irregular boundaries.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of approximately three circular high-contrast rings (white on black) on the mid-left lobe; additional singular circular high-intensity points on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe, oriented vertically across the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and potential tissue loss along the trailing edge; presence of multiple circular scarring patterns consistent with parasitic or barnacle attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, high-intensity textured protrusions (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
